Warnings array is empty even for malformed HTML (parser is lenient)

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Unclosed paragraph<div>Mixed nesting</p></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
debugPrint(result.warnings())
```
